# Quick Reference {.unnumbered}

<!-- AI-EDIT(2026-06-11): GAP-R345-6 — needs review: Discard row changed to right-click; Sync row location added -->

| Action    | How-To                                                      |
|:----------|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| Stage     | Source Control (+)                                          |
| Commit    | Type msg + ✔                                                |
| View Diff | Click file in Source Control                                |
| Discard   | Right-click file in Source Control → **Discard Changes**    |
| Branch    | Bottom-left status bar                                      |
| Sync      | **Sync Changes** button in Source Control (appears after you commit) |

<!-- AI-EDIT(2026-06-11): GAP-R345-6 — needs review -->
**Where is Sync Changes?** After you commit, the **Sync Changes** button appears in the Source Control panel (it may be blue or green, or say *Publish Branch*). Clicking it uploads your commits to GitHub so they are visible in the online repository.
